title: ProvenanceV1
description: Normative provenance tracking contract for SIH26168 defining evidence identity, session/stream context, hardware/build lineage, and upstream evidence consumption.

evidence_id.description: Globally unique observation identifier ensuring first-presentation evidence consumption.

stream_id.description: Identifier of the sensor, provider, or processing pipeline stream.

build_id.description: Software build version, release tag, or git commit SHA.

provenance_type.description: Operational origin classification of the observation.

contributing_evidence_ids.description: Array of upstream evidence IDs consumed by derived filters or fusion components.
